Post 1

📉 Earnings season bites. ASX 200 shed 41.20pts or 0.45% to 9,209.40 Wednesday, sitting 0.94% off its 52-week high. Consumer names cratered on results while utilities surged — a market splitting at the seams. #ASX #ausbiz

Post 2

🔻 Consumer Discretionary -0.81%, dragged by brutal earnings prints. Utilities the lone bright spot at +2.64%, likely on defensive rotation. A-REITs slipped 1.02%. When safety trades into poles, risk appetite is fading fast. #ASX #utilities #ausbiz

Post 3

📉 SEK collapsed 14.31% to AUD 13.770 and PMV dropped 11.01% to AUD 11.960 — two earnings landmines in one session. Consumer spending stress is showing up in results, not just surveys. #ASX #consumerstaples #ausbiz

Post 4

🪙 Gold at AUD 6,255.46/oz with AUD/USD at 0.7049. Silver AUD 94.04/oz. Platinum AUD 2,563.59/oz. Metals holding firm as the currency stays soft — a quiet tailwind for local producers. #ASX #gold #metals

Post 5

Watch the AUD/USD 0.7049 handle. A break higher compresses local gold returns below AUD 6,255/oz and squeezes materials margins. Earnings season still live — are you buying the consumer wreckage or waiting for the dust to settle? #ASX #ausbiz #FX
